summary.result: As shown in this study, heightening of agricultural reservoir provides positive effects in flood control and flood damage reduction.
summary.background: Annual average precipitation of Korea is 1,277 mm and around 2/3 of annual precipitation and 74 % of available water resources occurred during monsoon period.
summary.method: In recent years, many agricultural reservoirs have been heightened to increase flood control capacity, reduce flooding damage at downstream areas, and provide sustainable environmental flow during drought period.
